name: Create Account (multi-step)
complexityReason: Multi-step registration (/register/regpersonalinfo …): name/email/password with live rules (≥10 & ≤64 chars, no name/email, no common patterns), myWalgreens link opt-in, Terms consent, US state legal notices (CA under-16, CO consumer data). Identity-service integrated. Rendered pre-auth but full flow is gated.
functional: Collect first/last name, email, password (with live strength rules).
Multi-step continue → account provisioning via /profile/v1/checkAccount + registration.
acceptance: Password rules enforced inline before continue.
Required fields + Terms consent gate submission.
verify: Detailed manual verification required in a live session.

name: Forgot / Reset Password (OTP/MFA)
complexityReason: Password reset with email/SMS OTP + pincode validation (/profile/v1/resetPassword, sendCode, validate/pincode). MFA + session/CSRF.
functional: Set a new password with the same rules.
acceptance: New password enforces the rule set.
verify: Detailed manual verification required in a live session.

name: Account Dashboard
complexityReason: Post-login landing (/youraccount/default.jsp, /mywalgreens/dashboard.jsp): orders, refills, rewards, saved items, profile shortcuts. Auth-gated; documented from bundles.
functional: Surfaces order status, prescription refills, rewards balance, saved items and profile links.
Entry point to all account sub-sections.
acceptance: Dashboard shows the member's orders/refills/rewards; links resolve to each section.
verify: Detailed manual verification required in a live session.

name: myWalgreens Rewards
complexityReason: Walgreens Cash rewards balance, offers and history (/balancerewards/*, myWagRewardsInfo). Loyalty-service integrated.
functional: Show Walgreens Cash balance + earned/available rewards.
acceptance: Balance and offers reflect the member account.
verify: Detailed manual verification required in a live session.

name: Family / Caregiver Management
complexityReason: Manage family members & caregiver access levels (/familymgmt/members/fullaccess, /selectedMember). Permissions + HIPAA-sensitive.
functional: Add/manage family members and their access levels.
Switch selected member context for pharmacy actions.
acceptance: Members can be added and access levels set; selection scopes subsequent actions.
verify: Detailed manual verification required in a live session.

name: Health History
complexityReason: Health records / history (/profiles/{id}/healthhistory, /healthhistorydetail, /userhealthhistory). HIPAA-regulated, auth + DOB gated.
functional: View/enter health history (conditions, allergies, medications) per profile.
acceptance: Records display per authenticated profile; edits persist.
verify: Detailed manual verification required in a live session.

name: Rx Settings / Insurance
complexityReason: Prescription preferences + insurance on file (/rx-settings, svc/insurance/status). Pharmacy-service integrated.
functional: Manage insurance on file and Rx preferences (auto-refill, notifications).
acceptance: Insurance status shows and can be updated; preferences persist.
verify: Detailed manual verification required in a live session.

name: Secure Pharmacy Messaging
functional: View and send secure messages with the pharmacy.
acceptance: Threads display; new messages send and appear in history.
verify: Detailed manual verification required in a live session.
